rules.rule_description: Precharge cells align to raw bitline pitch at the array column edge, including optional replica-bitline extra column.
rules.required_geometry: Per-column precharge cell placement and BL/BR pin shapes.
rules.required_metadata: column offsets, column mirror parity, has_rbl side.

rules.rule_description: Column mux sits between raw BL/BR and word-owned read/write stages, with reserved select/output routing height.
rules.required_geometry: Mux bbox, select rail channels, output join rails.

rules.rule_description: Sense amps align to word outputs, not every raw column, so words-per-row controls their x ownership.
rules.required_geometry: Word-level sense amp positions and output pin geometry.

rules.rule_description: Write drivers align to word outputs and handle spare columns separately from regular word lanes.
rules.required_geometry: Per-word write-driver geometry and enable rails.

rules.rule_description: BL/BR must connect through a physical chain: array <-> precharge <-> mux/sense/write, depending on mode and words-per-row.
rules.required_geometry: Distinct pin-to-pin routes for each consumer stage.
rules.required_metadata: mode-aware chain ownership and net aliases.

rules.rule_description: Each column path stage exports local VDD/GND rails that must be stitched to top-level power with real taps.
rules.required_geometry: Stage-local rail shapes and tap landing points.
rules.required_metadata: supply layer, edge orientation, top strap targets.
